title: Draconia hero roster

identityLayers.race: Two small shared passives and one situational racial trait, independent of faction and class.
identityLayers.class: One fixed class defines the permitted skill pool, weapon identity and progression discipline. Respec never changes it.
identityLayers.faction: Starting ties, town, recruitment/service doctrine and political obligations.
identityLayers.hero: One individually authored exclusive signature with its own trigger, consequence and counterplay; it is not shared by the rest of the class.
identityLayers.build: Spend attributes and class talents, prepare class skills, choose equipment and oaths within the chosen identity.

implementationBoundary: All 156 champions now have fixed class, race and faction IDs and an individually authored personal signature. Only Mara is playable. Class permission enforcement and supportedSkills are runtime systems; the other champions, signatures, class-resource traits and racial packages remain design targets unless a trait explicitly says implemented. No hero swapping or second playable hero.
